The '''Jedi training cruiser''', also known as the '''Jedi cruiser''', was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] model used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']] served as a transport for the Jedi Order. Professor [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] maintained his workshop aboard it for over 1,000 years.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was used by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to transport a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], where they underwent the ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]]. On the way back from the mission, it was attacked by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and boarded. Padawan Tano was captured by the pirates during the Jedi's subsequent escape when the ship went into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

During the escape, the coolant system of the vessel was ruptured and in order to allow the system to restart they land the ship on the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. After having rescued Tano, the younglings tried to escape using the Crucible. However, the pirates chasing the younglings shot the engines of the Crucible and it crashed, unable to fly with the damage it had sustained.

==Behind the scenes==
The design of the Jedi training cruiser was based on the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] from the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Explore: A Test of Strength">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep507|text="A Test of Strength" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
